facts.fact: ThriveAgric, a Y Combinator-backed Nigerian agritech start-up, raised N5.3 billion (US$3.93 million) from unnamed institutional investors in Series 1 of a commercial paper programme of up to N50 billion, announced 25 August 2026 with Anchoria Advisory Services as lead issuing house.

ThriveAgric raised N5.3 billion in Series 1 of a commercial paper programme approved by Nigeria's SEC, its first use of Nigeria's debt capital market, from institutional investors the document does not name.

ThriveAgric received US$56.4 million in debt funding in 2022 from local commercial banks and institutional investors, including a US$1.75 million co-investment grant from the USAID-funded West Africa Trade & Investment Hub (US), per this document.
ThriveAgric's US$56.4 million debt funding in 2022 came in part from local commercial banks, per this document.

note: No digital-system entries; ThriveAgric is the recipient.
